name: facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-environments/gaia2-cli/core/gaia2_core/judge/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.hard_compare: run hard checkers on agent and oracle arguments and return pass or fail with rationale
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.soft_compare: run soft LLM-based checkers on agent and oracle arguments for semantic validation
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.mild_compare: run combined hard and soft comparison on agent and oracle events with rationale
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_llm_checkers: build all LLM checker instances for soft checking with configurable majority vote count
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.normalize_arg: normalize an argument string by lowercasing removing accents and stripping punctuation for comparison

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_checker_registries: build expanded arg-checker and soft-checker registries for eval or RL mode
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.check_checker_type_is_hard: check if a CheckerType enum value is a hard checker using is_hard method
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.check_checker_type_is_scripted: check if a CheckerType enum value is a scripted checker using is_scripted method
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.check_soft_checker_need_subtask: check if a SoftCheckerType requires a subtask using the need_subtask property
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.expand_app_aliases: expand a registry dictionary with app-level aliases using _expand_app_aliases

facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.build_judge_instance: build a Judge instance with oracle events, graph, tasks, and optional LLM engine for evaluation
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.run_judge_turn: run judge_turn to validate agent events against oracle events and return a JudgmentResult
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.test_preliminary_checks: test the preliminary checks that compare agent and oracle tool call counts for mismatches
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.refactor_oracle_placeholder_resolution: refactor the oracle placeholder resolution to replace event ID references with matched agent return values
facebookresearch_meta-agents-research-en.review_time_checking: review the time checking logic that enforces agent event timing within tolerance windows of oracle expectations
